from datetime import datetime
now=datetime.now()
this_year=now.year
last_year=this_year-1
print('now', now)
print('this_year', this_year, 'last_year', last_year)

token='eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzcG90aWZ5K3RpbW90aHkud2hpdEBnbWFpbC5jb20iLCJleHAiOjE2ODQ0MTIwOTh9.vcjzfUiUAXeSMl2SyhTMLrGfTDKg8H0mNUZKE8JmFIQ'

# all_recs from previous cell might not persist; but try
try:
    recs=all_recs
    print('using existing all_recs', len(recs))
except NameError:
    # refetch recommendations
    recs=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        page=apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        print('fetched page', page_index, 'count', len(page))
        if not page:
            break
        recs.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
    print('total recs', len(recs))

# Filter R&B + release year in {this_year,last_year}
selected=[]
seen=set()
for r in recs:
    sid=r.get('song_id')
    if sid is None or sid in seen:
        continue
    info=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    seen.add(sid)
    genre=info.get('genre')
    release_date=info.get('release_date')
    year=None
    if release_date:
        try:
            year=int(release_date[0:4])
        except Exception as e:
            year=None
    is_rnb = isinstance(genre,str) and genre.strip().lower()=='r&b'
    if is_rnb and year in (this_year,last_year):
        selected.append({
            'song_id': sid,
            'title': info.get('title'),
            'album_title': info.get('album_title'),
            'release_date': release_date,
            'genre': genre,
            'year': year
        })

print('selected_count', len(selected))
# sort by year then title
selected_sorted=sorted(selected, key=lambda x:(x['year'], x['title'] or ''))
print('selected_song_ids', [x['song_id'] for x in selected_sorted])
print('selected_details_sample', selected_sorted[:10])
